requirements.success_oracle: Display selected locale description with source revision and capability/permission context
requirements.negative_oracle: Missing en-US must display verified source text with visible fallback indicator, never invent translation or pretend install succeeds

requirements.success_oracle: Localized six-page navigation, ten project-detail sections, controls, errors, settings; keep theme light/dark/system, sidebar and project radar width independently
requirements.negative_oracle: Missing string or invalid locale must not change Scope, ACL, command, Evidence, R1, NodeGate or business date

acceptance_cases.assertion: zh-CN/en-US switch updates six-page navigation (5 main nav + sixth project-detail) and all 10 section names without deleting an entry
P05-03 localized skill name and description are tied to installed catalog version/source_ref, not unrelated translation
When en-US translation is unavailable show original verified text plus visible fallback flag, never empty or fabricated success
Changing locale cannot alter project_id/batch_id/release_date/requirement_id/system_version_id/sst_id or reconstruct relation edges
403/404/409/422/503 and UNKNOWN/STALE/HUMAN_GATE/BLOCKED remain unchanged as machine states when labels change
YYYY-MM-DD release date remains unchanged on locale change; BUSINESS_TZ unresolved goes to HOLD, never inferred or silently UTC-shifted
Per-authorized-user preference persists across refresh but cannot leak to other users/projects or overwrite host session state
Switch light/dark/system with en-US/zh-CN and collapse/restore sidebar and radar; invalid theme values are rejected without data damage
Unknown locale and missing translation key fail safely with visible fallback diagnostic, never mark QA_PASS or publish
Approval, evidence and NodeGate localized labels do not modify R1 decision or forge a Human Gate decision
Language switch keeps keyboard focus and screen-reader labels for all six pages and ten sections
No PolyForm Noncommercial upstream JS/CSS/template or unlicensed translated assets copied; originals require separate provenance and release gate
